The supplied inventory shows transition:line:57 is an untriggered guarded SearchMission-to-FormationAdjust route, and no event-qualified edge with Interception_Detected exists. The supplied facts place Interception_Detected on nested exit transitions, but no supplied equivalence proves those consumers select transition:line:57.
